items.text: The 4K fold glide on the published release now runs at about 100 frames a second instead of 40; the only frames still over budget are the 4 fold ticks a drag, so the T2457 close waits on T2941.
The frame a pane folds into its strip no longer redraws the whole desk, so a 4K fold glide has no frame over 16.7 ms on a release build.
